generatedFor: 51 public YouTube support channels / 54 support-language variants

notes: The eight routes do not raise the accepted aggregate upload allowance above the former four-route total.
A channel may be pre-authorized on its paired standby route, but publication must use only its one active supportChannelKeys assignment.
Changing a channel's active route is a reviewed config change; quota exhaustion never triggers automatic rerouting.

routingRules: A public support channel is assigned to exactly one YouTube API project route.
Regional support variants stay attached to their shared public channel: EN/EN-GB -> en, ES/ES-419 -> es, PT/PT-BR -> pt.
Routes are paired 1/5, 2/6, 3/7 and 4/8 for standby OAuth authorization only; standby authorization is not an active publication route.
Do not reroute or fail over a channel because its active route has exhausted quota.
All active routes together remain bounded by quotaPolicy.aggregateVideoUploadCallLimitPerQuotaDay.
Do not put OAuth token JSON, client secret JSON, refresh tokens, or .local files in this config.
Each real Google Cloud / YouTube API project must have its own GitHub environment secret bundle before live uploads use that route.
A route with publicationReady=false must fail before campaign metadata, render, TTS, YouTube or GitHub publication dispatch.
This file is a local routing contract only; creating Google Cloud projects, OAuth clients, production status, quota extension requests, and GitHub secrets are external steps.
